title: Audit 5: CI fails a pull request that moves package.json version
notes:
A CI step compares package.json version with the base branch and fails a pull request that changed it, except the release workflow's commit. workflow-rule-3.

From the CLAUDE.md audit, docs/workflow/claude-md-audit.md (card fad098f2). The rule stays in CLAUDE.md until card 13 deletes it.

comments.body: Shipped in #277: CI step 'Refuse a moved version' (scripts/version-unchanged.mjs + step, tested) fails a pull request whose merge commit's package.json version differs from its base. Push-to-main runs (Release's commit) skip it. CLAUDE.md line left for Audit 13.
